description:
With 'when is_list(funs)' (alone or joined with 'and is_list(inner)') on the %Stream{} clause of Enumerable.Stream.reduce in lib/stream.fz, the distiller fails on interp and run: 'artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan: compiler2 materialization for root 0: public closure callsite 0 settled return `any` disagrees with its semantic result type `{:cont, any}`', located at <generated>. A guard on inner alone compiles. Reproduces with develop's src/compiler2/contract.rs (so it is not caused by fz-i89).
Smallest program found: 74 lines, scratchpad/i89/g/min2.exs (File.stream! |> Stream.map(&JSON.decode!/1) |> Enum.to_list, OptionParser.parse, Enum.group_by |> Enum.map with Enum.frequencies_by |> Map.values); its message is '... disagrees with its semantic result type `{:cont, not(%{:__struct__: atom})}`'. A standalone struct with the same guard (scratchpad/i89/g/g1.fz) passes, as do plain stream programs.
Not investigated: why the settled return of the closure callsite stays any while the semantic result is narrower; which ingredient of min2 is necessary.
Fails before, passes after: min2 reduced to a fixture runs on all three paths with the guard on funs in lib/stream.fz.
Acceptance: full gate green; no pin rises unexplained.
title: A list guard on a Stream's funs field compiles the distiller
